grades: Rising sophomore, junior or senior (preference for rising juniors and seniors)
name: High School Summer Research Academy (HSRA)
org: College of Natural Sciences, The University of Texas at Austin
what_you_do: Join a UT College of Natural Sciences lab for five weeks, about 15 to 25 hours a week. Present a poster at the closing symposium and earn UT extension course credit.
who_can_apply: Texas residents are prioritized. You must be 15 or older by June 1, 2027 and available all five weeks. In person only. You arrange your own housing and transportation.
pay_detail: Summer 2027 tuition is $4,500. Payment is due only after you accept a lab placement. Financial aid is not mentioned on the page.
duration: 5 weeks, June 7 to July 14, 2027 (off June 18 and July 5)
deadline_text: The 2027 application opens mid January 2027. Deadline is listed as March 2027 (no day). Late applications may be accepted on a limited basis.
how_to_apply: Apply online when the application opens in mid January 2027. First round notices go out at the end of April and second round in early May, with a deposit due one week after you accept. Email hsra@utexas.edu.
notes: This costs a lot and is hard to get into. The page says a few need-based scholarships may be available. They give a stipend plus free tuition. There are no merit scholarships now. Your lab spot is based on your interests, your free time and space. Full tuition is due in mid May.
